snapshot_digest.canonical_stream: For every regular file beneath the snapshot, sort relative paths by raw byte value under LC_ALL=C. Emit one UTF-8 line per file as '<normalized-mode> <decimal-byte-count> <lowercase-file-sha256>\t<relative-path>\n'. normalized-mode is 100755 when the extracted file is executable and 100644 otherwise. Hash the concatenated lines. Git contains no empty directories, and these snapshots contain no symlinks.
snapshot_digest.independent_identity_check: A temporary Git index was populated from each revision and refreshed against the extracted work tree. git diff-index reported no regular-file or mode difference with submodule links ignored; the extracted regular-file count also exactly equals the corresponding Git regular-blob count. No .git directory is present.
snapshot_digest.git_archive_tar_digest_note: The additional archive digest is SHA-256 of the uncompressed byte stream produced by git 2.34.1 using 'git archive --format=tar <revision>'.
snapshot_digest.gitlink_policy: The tracked .gitmodules file is preserved. git archive does not expand Git submodule links, so third_party/benchmark and third_party/pybind11 are intentionally absent and their exact gitlink object IDs are recorded per snapshot. The focal onnx/hub.py procedure does not depend on either submodule.

source.subject: Add ONNX model hub python client (#3663)

frozen_property_check.focal_assumption: For an ONNX Hub model download, downloaded artifact contents cannot select additional filesystem write destinations; the Hub client writes only to the single cache path it constructs before downloading.
frozen_property_check.source: onnx/hub.py load constructs local_model_path from Hub metadata before download and passes that single path to wget.download. It then reads that same file into memory; no archive import, member iteration, or extraction is present.
frozen_property_check.compatible: onnx/hub.py load preserves the same one-path behavior, now through _download_file(url, local_model_path). Neither the helper nor load performs archive handling or content-directed extraction.
frozen_property_check.invalidated: onnx/hub.py adds download_model_with_test_data. After downloading one tar.gz file to a precomputed path, it opens the artifact with tarfile.open and calls extractall on a derived directory, so archive member names select additional write destinations.
frozen_property_check.conclusion: Executable inspection does not contradict the frozen p*(S)=TRUE, p*(C)=TRUE, p*(I)=FALSE conclusions. I is a sibling Hub retrieval procedure, as the frozen review explicitly requires.

runtime_assessment.project_runtime: Python Hub client inside the ONNX source distribution; a normal full onnx import depends on the project's generated/compiled bindings.

dependency_metadata.source: requirements.txt declares numpy>=1.16.6, protobuf, six, typing-extensions>=3.6.2.1, and wget.
dependency_metadata.compatible: requirements.txt declares numpy>=1.16.6, protobuf>=3.12.2,<4, and typing-extensions>=3.6.2.1; hub.py uses urllib rather than wget.
dependency_metadata.invalidated: requirements.txt declares numpy>=1.16.6, protobuf>=3.20.2,<4, and typing-extensions>=3.6.2.1; hub.py uses urllib and Python's tarfile module.

runtime_assessment.bounded_retrieval_result: Source trees and relevant history are fully materialized. No dependency installation, package build, submodule checkout, model download, or test-data download was performed in this phase.
